system_prompt: Configure training of ONE shared steady 2D lid-driven-cavity PINN on FlowBench harmonics. Inputs are obstacle geometry and Reynolds number; outputs are steady u,v,p, not time rollout. The fixed geometry-conditioned coordinate model predicts streamfunction/pressure; velocity is its curl. Loss = mean([du^2,dv^2,pressure_weight*dp^2]/TRAIN_std^2) + physics_weight*steady_NS_loss + bc_weight*no_slip_loss. The PDE includes convection, pressure gradient, viscosity 1/Re and continuity. All candidates use the SAME architecture, 640 TRAIN/160 VAL split, optimizer, training seed, 2048 data/64 PDE/128 boundary points per case and 4 cases per update. No TEST values are available. Only the five permitted parameters may change. Physics weight must remain positive. Adam uses cosine decay to 5% of its initial learning rate; PDE warmup is warmup_fraction of all updates, followed by a fixed 0.03125-fraction linear ramp. Normalize each field using TRAIN-only std. Minimize validation mean unweighted all-cell u/v/p MSE after predicted pressure gauge and known solid masking. Velocity/pressure relative L2 and finite-difference NS/divergence are additional reported diagnostics; low divergence alone does not establish physical accuracy. Require full 512x512 p99 inference <=5ms on H200. This is a TWO-EPOCH TECHNICAL WIRING TEST, not a converged accuracy comparison or an independent repetition. The supplied history contains genuine measured two-epoch trials; do not invent measurements. No tools, code execution, internet, files or additional data access. Return ONE JSON object with exactly keys parameters,reason,evidence_ids,expected_effect,risk. parameters must contain exactly learning_rate,pressure_weight,physics_weight,bc_weight,warmup_fraction. learning_rate real [0.0001,0.002]; pressure_weight one of [0.5,1,2]; physics_weight one of [0.0001,0.0003,0.001,0.003,0.01]; bc_weight one of [0.001,0.003,0.01,0.03,0.1]; warmup_fraction one of [0,0.03125,0.0625]. reason,expected_effect,risk must be nonempty brief public statements, at most 120 words combined. evidence_ids must be unique IDs of completed trials in the supplied history and include latest_required_id. Use actual supplied measurements in explanations and distinguish expectations from measured results. Duplicates consume an attempt and recorded resources. No Markdown or text outside JSON.

generation.seed_policy: 270100+round, same across families; not main independent repetition

fixed: Own V26 shared geometry/Re coordinate streamfunction PINN; same native full-field query. All 640 TRAIN and 160 VAL cases; 200 TEST targets sealed. TRAIN-only normalizer. Batch4, 2048 data/64 PDE/128 BC per case, Adam/cosine/gradient clip1, fixed architecture and no per-case network.
schedule: Warmup fraction of exact trial updates; fixed 0.03125 ramp fraction. Two-epoch technical trial320updates means baseline warmup10/ramp10; 400epoch reference would use2000/2000. PDE coefficient remains positive after ramp.
sampling: Independent deterministic order/data/PDE/BC RNG streams, sample PDE points even during warmup. Same seed and sample hash across all fresh technical trials. Not source V26 RNG bitwise reproduction.
fair_budget: All methods use same five-parameter space and full 2 TRAIN epochs. Checkpoint selected by mean unweighted all-cell u/v/p VAL MSE; pressure gauge/mask. No architecture or epoch proposals; positive physics required. Bad formats have one model repair; no manual parameter changes. Duplicate proposals consume full attempt/resources.
model_policy: Pinned local checkpoints with full compute-node SHA checks before use; no network/API. Qwen/Granite thinking disabled. Ministral published FP8 is dequantized to BF16; not recovered original BF16. Public brief explanation is logged, not a hidden reasoning trace.
pipeline: One common real baseline trial, then four parallel one-GPU workers. Each worker: proposal1 -> fresh PINN train1 -> actual VAL feedback -> proposal2 citing trial1 -> fresh train2. Worker0 also one actual random ask/train/tell;worker1 one actual TPE ask/train/tell. CPU sampler tests cover the same space. End-to-end review verifies hashes and matching sampler/initial weights.
resources: Record prompt/reply/repair/transports, tokens, first-token/generation/load/process wall and CPU, sampled GPU/RSS, PINN peak allocation, actual Slurm allocated GPU/core seconds. Whole 4GPU job allocation includes common-start idle GPUs and worker-tail idle time; never sum child runtimes as total billed allocation.
timing: Use frozen V26 full 512x512 benchmark with native input pooling+encoder+MLP+curl+gauge+mask,30warmup200repeat1TRAIN1VAL,p99<=5ms before/after every technical trial. Not host transfer/rendering.
safety: No reading main 200 TEST labels, no new CFD/downloads, no copying large data/weights locally, no edits of frozen V26 or its running job. Technical two-epoch metrics cannot establish LLM superiority or final accuracy.
